status: authored design constraints; not reconstructed anatomy or passing 3D evidence

axes: y forward, positive toward face viewer
coordinates.origin: mask chin at z=0; mask midline x=0; y=0 nominal cheek field
coordinates.world_transform: artist must apply one common orthonormal transform to every landmark; do not independently scale features

surface_rules: Create one continuous mask shell; feature curves are surface landmarks, not separate decorative mesh strips.
Use a face patch network with explicit eye-boundary loops. Do not delete rectangular grid cells or cut axis-aligned boxes for eye apertures.
Mirror positive-x eye/cheek landmarks for opposite side. Keep quiet closed mouth, hollow eyes and narrow long face; no grin or barred visor.
Bridge brow/cheek/nose/mouth rings with continuous quads where practical; place topology poles away from eyelid corners and nose silhouette.
Outer side returns curve backward around temples/jaw. Nose projects locally, not the entire mask as a wedge.
Small shell thickness is physical; cavity behind eye loops must remain dark/open without a rear head surface filling the aperture.
Fit mask and hood to a real head volume, preserving space for back skull. Never replace hidden depth with a front cutout extrusion.

outer_boundary_positive.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot
outer_boundary_positive.note: Mirror and reverse to close; round local corner tangents without inflating face.

eye_positive.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot
eye_positive.note: Inner corner begins loop; outer corner does not form square cutout. Depth bends around orbital field.

brow_positive.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot

lower_orbit_positive.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot

nose_side_positive.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot
nose_side_positive.note: Narrow bridge; alar transition returns toward cheek before mouth.

cheek_to_jaw_positive.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot

mouth_upper.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot

mouth_slit.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot
mouth_slit.note: Shallow continuous recessed seam, not open smile or black rectangle; no separate tube lip.

mouth_lower.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot

midline_profile.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot

hood_opening_positive.interpolation: shape-preserving cubic; retain extrema; no overshoot
hood_opening_positive.note: Mirror; the rim frames temples but drops clear of jaw and turns over shoulder, not a straight tube.

hood.construction: one crown/nape shell with separate face opening and shoulder-supported cowl; no long vertical tube or horizontal nape shelf
hood.hem_rule: face opening turns into cowl; do not run two straight edges to shoulder as separate ribbons

shoulder_yoke.coordinates: same normalized frame, z below mask chin negative; scale together with head
fold_constraints: Load at actual shoulder support; valley depths 0.08–0.16 units across broad spans, not repeated ripples.
Rear centre continues into cloak gores; no exposed rectangular top tab.
Front left casting-arm boundary stays medial to deltoid; keep an actual arm opening.
Fit against measured body envelope; these targets do not override no-intersection constraints.

review_gates: Front: elongated face, slanted almond eye apertures, visible cheek and narrow quiet mouth; no blank oval.
Side: distinct forehead–nose bridge–tip–lip–chin rhythm and backward temple return, not a beak slab.
Three-quarter: cheek plane joins nose and jaw; eye openings remain continuous and shell does not intersect hood.
Rear/shoulder: hood carries skull depth and settles into curved yoke; no floating ledge or flat cape root.
Neutral clay first. No noise/ornament/material to conceal surface or silhouette failure.
